chapter: Benny Meroff and Chicago's jazz scene
title: Salary and the make-up of the Meroff band
summary: He earns $11,500 a year at 22 and spends it on cars, booze and chorus girls; the band has twelve violins, two pianos, tuba and string bass.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And, you stayed with him over five (5) years - didn't you?
Yeah and the money -- today I don't
know what that money would be but I was making $11,500 a year and I was just a kid--- really mid-

But, can you imagine what $11,500 would be today-- well, anyway, as I said - that's a lot of money because being a guy that never really made any great big money, I didn't know what to do with it. I bought big cars and lots of booze and chased chorus girls.

Some fancy coats and hats but, anyway, this was a band; this was a brand new ball game for me. They had four trumpets; three cornets and two trumpets and two cornets which are four--- they had two French horns -- they had three trombones; six saxophones; two pianos---
Yes and about eight (8) or twelve (12) violins---
And a string bass and a tuba - a tuba with brass side of the band and a string bass with a string side of the band and, uh, all special arrangements.
